newsitem.title: USA: Metrocall extends deadline for A+ notes.
newsitem.headline: Metrocall extends deadline for A+ notes.

text.p: Metrocall Inc said Friday it is extending the deadline of its consent solicitation for indenture governing A+ Network Inc's 11-7/8 percent senior subordinated notes to 1700 EST on November 5.
The expiration date for the notes, which are due 2005, was initially set at midnight on November 1.
The deadline for Metrocall's related tender offer for the A+ Notes will remain midnight on November 6, the company said.
As of the close of business on October 31, $121,483,000 in aggregate principal amount of the A+ notes has been tendered.
